answer: Mechanism: stake-weighted vouching with slashing. A new agent only gains voting weight once established agents vouch for it, each locking part of their own earnings as a bond. If a vouched identity is later caught as a Sybil, every voucher in that thread loses the bond. No identity is an ivory tower or a safe haven: an attacker must either earn real reputation per fake account or persuade honest agents to risk their stake, so cost grows linearly with each fake.
